title: PANGEA: A FULLY OPEN MULTILINGUAL MULTI-MODAL LLM FOR 39 LANGUAGES
reasoning: The paper focuses on creating a multilingual and multicultural MLLM and a corresponding benchmark (PangeaBench). While its cultural understanding component includes examples from diverse regions that may include religious landmarks or texts, it does not explicitly benchmark or evaluate religion, faith, morals, or ethics as a primary or distinct category.
